text:
Ava (Sales): Handoff for Verdant Labs - signed 12mo Dedicated. PoC good, exec sponsor committed. Passing to CS for onboarding + compliance items.

Ava (Sales): Quick asks from customer: Okta SSO+SCIM, VPC peering (preferred window 02:00-05:00 UTC), private model mount for PHI evals, capacity plan for 3 rps steady with 8 rps spikes.

Priya (CS): I'll own onboarding. Owners: Priya (onboarding lead), Ravi (infra/peering), Sam (support/runbook & pager), Devin (smoke tests + prompts).

Priya (CS): Pre-kickoff asks: customer SSO metadata, public ASN, CIDR allowlist, expected hourly QPS curve, and confirmation DPA/BAA signed.

Ava (Sales): Procurement confirmed DPA signed. Contact: infra@verdantlabs.com (Mira). ASN pending, will get before EOD.

Ravi (Infra): Need ASN + CIDRs to configure peering. HSM ETA for Dedicated tenants ~6 weeks; KMS with customer-managed keys available now. I'll post a short compliance note for procurement.

Devin (Solutions): I'll prepare a 10-prompt smoke set (short/long/few-shot) and a small python harness. Quick curl example for their infra to validate after SSO:
curl -s -X POST https://dedicated.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"redwood-7b-ded","input":"ping"}'

Sam (Support): I'll create ticket VER-300 and add checklist: SSO verify, SCIM provisioning test, peering verify, model mount verify, smoke tests, canary cutover, and 30-day oncall rota.

ops-bot: Ticket VER-300 created by Sam (Support) - https://support.redwood.ai/VER-300

Priya (CS): Action items (owners):
- Priya: schedule kickoff + weekly checkpoints; own risk register
- Ravi: validate VPC peering config + confirm KMS/HSM note (owner)
- Devin: upload smoke tests + harness to /shared/verdant (owner)
- Sam: populate VER-300 with alerting/playbook and rotation (owner)

Priya (CS): Renewal risk note: if HSM not available within 45 days procurement may request additional controls. Flagging as medium risk until compliance note posted.

Ravi (Infra): I'll run staging capacity test tomorrow and post p95 numbers to VER-300. Preliminary expectation: ~220-260ms p95 @512 tokens on a40-class with continuous batching.

Devin (Solutions): Uploaded initial smoke CSV to /shared/verdant-tests. Will attach pass thresholds after staging run.

Sam (Support): Oncall thresholds for first 14 days: page on error-rate >1.5% or p95 >400ms. Will link escalation path in VER-300.

Priya (CS): Kickoff scheduled Thu 14:00 UTC. Please add any pre-kick docs to /shared/verdant by Wed EOD. Primary success metrics: go-live <=30d, p95 <300ms steady, smoke pass, zero Sev1 first 14d.

Ava (Sales): Thanks team  I'll join kickoff and introduce Verdant AM.

Priya (CS): Nice handoff. Owners please update VER-300 as items progress.
